Q1001.reason: One rental period's notice ending June 30 was timely for this month-to-month tenancy, and termination served immediately after the habitability victory is retaliatory eviction, which defeats the possession claim.

Q1008.reason: The guard's gun threat was outrageous conduct done with the barber present and with knowledge of his heart disease, so third-party IIED lies when that distress produces bodily harm.

Q938.reason: Chest compressions are effective only with the patient supine on a firm surface so the sternum can be driven against a solid base.
